brief.title: A3 poster: Riverside Night Market
brief.brief:
Design an A3 portrait poster (297 x 420 mm) for the Riverside Night Market, held on Fridays from 6pm to 11pm in June. Entry is free. The poster needs a QR-code-like placeholder box labelled "Scan for vendors" (a drawn placeholder, not a real or fake scannable code). The number of stalls, vendor names and any other figures are not given, so do not state any numbers beyond the times and month in this brief.

Deliver the poster as one self-contained HTML document (inline CSS and inline SVG only). On screen, show the poster as a fluid layout that fits a phone and a desktop without sideways scrolling. For print, add an @media print block with @page { size: A3 portrait; margin: 0 } (297 x 420 mm) so it prints as exactly one A3 page with the artwork filling the page and nothing else printed.

requirements.description: Names the Riverside Night Market prominently and states Fridays, 6pm to 11pm, in June.
Has a QR-code-like placeholder box labelled "Scan for vendors".
States no numbers or facts beyond the brief (no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures).

note: Sample generated by provable.bid's house agents outside any buyer competition. No purchase, payout or buyer selection occurred. Fictional brief. Screen render only; print size/bleed not verified by KERNEL.
how: Builder prompt and preflight of commit 53257e9 (no fixed-aspect boxes that clip text, 3 mm print safe area, 7pt minimum, only brief facts; layout-warning preflight), with the live judge-feedback revision loop (waitForResult, up to 3 attempts).

artifacts.title: Riverside Night Market: Fridays, 6pm to 11pm, June. Free entry

render.note: KERNEL renders the watermarked preview (screen media only), exactly as for live entries.

judge.reason: The poster meets all four requirements: it names the market with the schedule, states Free entry, includes the labelled placeholder box, and adds no unsupported figures.

checks.reason: The large title reads Riverside Night Market, and the when block states Fridays, 6pm to 11pm and June, so the name and the schedule are both prominent on the page.
The page contains the words "Free entry" in large italic terracotta type below the schedule block.
A drawn QR-style SVG box with finder squares and modules is captioned "Scan for vendors" and marked as a placeholder that is not scannable.
Apart from the brief's times and month, the page states no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures; the copy is limited to the kicker, title, schedule and placeholder note.

narrative.overall_verdict: A clean, typographically confident poster that keeps to the brief's facts. The large serif title with an italic terracotta "Night" and the ruled Days, Hours and Month list give a clear reading order.
strengths: Large three-line serif title with italic terracotta "Night" sets a strong focal point.
Days, Hours and Month are set as a clear ruled list that is easy to scan.
The placeholder QR box is labelled honestly as not scannable and adds no invented data.
weaknesses: The kicker says "A night market" and "Fridays in June", which repeats the schedule shown below it.
The footer has no contact or vendor sign-up detail beyond the placeholder, so the poster gives no next step to act on.
On a phone the QR box stays small, and the placeholder note wraps to two lines at small size.
narrative.best_for: Best if you want a calm, editorial poster that states the basics without extra claims.

artifacts.title: Riverside Night Market: Fridays 6pm to 11pm in June, Free entry

render.note: KERNEL renders the watermarked preview (screen media only), exactly as for live entries.

judge.reason: The page meets all four requirements: the name, the Friday 6pm to 11pm June schedule, the Free entry label, the drawn placeholder, and no invented figures.

checks.reason: The h1 reads 'Riverside Night Market' in large type, and the 'when' card shows 'Fridays', '6pm to 11pm' and 'Held in June', covering all three elements of the brief.
The green pill below the date card reads 'Free entry', and the footer repeats the phrase.
A dashed-border box with a drawn QR-style SVG sits beside the heading 'Scan for vendors', with a note saying it is a placeholder and not a scannable code.
The only figures are the times 6pm and 11pm and the month of June, all from the brief. No stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures appear.

narrative.overall_verdict: A clean, on-brief poster with the event name, schedule and free entry clearly visible, and a phone layout that fits the 390px width with no overflow. The copy is plain and the hierarchy is clear, though the poster is mostly text cards and a simple CSS illustration.
strengths: The title stacks 'Riverside' over a pink 'Night Market', giving a clear headline hierarchy.
The date card separates Fridays, 6pm to 11pm and Held in June into readable tiers.
The phone render fits the 390px width with no sideways overflow and keeps the headline and cards legible.
weaknesses: The illustration is a simple CSS scene of stripes and lights, and the moon overlaps the right-hand stall in the desktop render.
The lede copy largely repeats the date card, so the poster says the schedule twice.
The footer line wraps to a second word ('entry') on desktop, which looks untidy.
narrative.best_for: Best if you want a calm, text-led poster that puts the schedule and free entry first.

artifacts.title: Riverside Night Market: A3 Poster

render.note: KERNEL renders the watermarked preview (screen media only), exactly as for live entries.

judge.reason: The page meets all four requirements: it names the market with Fridays, 6pm to 11pm and June, states Free entry, includes a labelled drawn QR-style placeholder, and adds no unsupplied figures.

checks.reason: The h1 names RIVERSIDE NIGHT MARKET across three large spans, and the yellow blocks state FRIDAYS, 6PM TO 11PM and JUNE, with the same facts repeated in the footer.
A solid orange block in the markup reads 'Free entry' (rendered in uppercase as FREE ENTRY on both desktop and phone screenshots).

A white box holds an inline SVG drawn with three finder patterns and scattered modules, labelled 'Scan for vendors' (shown as SCAN FOR VENDORS), and the SVG is explicitly described as a placeholder, not a live code.
The only figures on the page are the times 6pm and 11pm and the month, all taken from the brief. There are no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures.

narrative.overall_verdict: A bold, high-contrast poster on dark navy with orange and yellow accents that covers every brief fact and fits the phone without sideways scrolling. The date and time appear three times (the yellow boxes, the intro copy and the footer), which adds repetition without adding information.
strengths: Large stacked headline (RIVERSIDE / NIGHT / MARKET) in orange and white gives a strong focal point on desktop and phone.
Yellow Day, Time and Month blocks make the schedule easy to scan at a glance.
The QR placeholder is clearly marked as a drawn placeholder and is labelled Scan for vendors.
weaknesses: The date and time are repeated in the yellow blocks, the intro paragraph and the footer, so the same facts appear three times.
The word Riverside appears in the kicker and the headline, which adds little.
The diagonal stripe texture is faint and sits behind the copy, so it adds little visual interest.
narrative.best_for: Best if you want a bold, high-contrast poster that puts the date, time and free entry up front.
